tbesh_html:
1) if it please, pray excuse me, excuse me please
1a) used to introduce an entreaty or request

strongs_1890.strongs_def: oh that!; with leave, or if it please
strongs_1890.derivation: perhaps from H1158 (בָּעָה) (in the sense of asking); properly, a request; used only adverbially (always with 'my Lord');
